newsitem.title: USA: Divine Brown convicted of prostitution charge.
newsitem.headline: Divine Brown convicted of prostitution charge.

text.p: Divine Brown, a Hollywood hooker made famous after she was arrested engaging in a sex act with British actor Hugh Grant, was fined nearly $1,000 on Tuesday after pleading guilty to charges of prostitution and resisting arrest, a court spokeswoman said on Wednesday.
Clark County Court Judge Deborah Lippis fined Brown, whose real name is Estella Maria Thompson, $950, the spokeswoman said. A third count of aiding and abetting prostitution was dismissed.
Brown was arrested in September at the MGM Grand Hotel and Casino in Las Vegas in a "sting" operation by vice squad officers, police said. She was released on bail the day after her arrest.
Brown, 23, became famous last year when she and Grant were arrested after vice squad officers spotted them engaging in a sex act in Grant's car near Sunset Boulevard in Los Angeles.

Grant, star of such films as "Four Weddings and a Funeral," publicly apologised for the scandal that for a time seemed to threaten his career as well as his relationship with his girlfriend, model Liz Hurley.
Grant was fined $1,800 and Brown was fined $1,350 and given a jail term of 180 days over the Los Angeles incident.
